summary_1line: Grief-stricken Drona continues battling Dhrishtadyumna with dwindling power as the Panchala prince relentlessly attacks to fulfill his destined mission of killing him.

image_candidates.scene_text: Dhrishtadyumna leaps from his shattered chariot, sword and moon-decked shield raised, charging at the weary Drona like Garuda swooping upon a serpent.
Drona’s arrows slice apart Dhrishtadyumna’s weapons and chariot as the two warriors clash amid tangled red and white horses on the battlefield.
With sword and shield flashing, Dhrishtadyumna darts around Drona’s chariot yoke and horses, performing swift martial maneuvers while soldiers and gods watch in awe.
